title: Postcomposition by a fully faithful functor is fully faithful
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$ be categories [def-nagata-category] in fixed universes, enlarged for the functor categories if needed. A functor assigns objects and morphisms preserving identities and composition. Write $[\mathcal C,\mathcal D]$ for the category of functors and natural transformations, where $\eta:F\Rightarrow G$ is a family $\eta_x:F(x)\to G(x)$ satisfying $G(u)\eta_x=\eta_yF(u)$ for every $u:x\to y$, with identities and composition componentwise. Let $H:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ be fully faithful, meaning its map on every Hom set is bijective. Then the postcomposition functor
$$H_*:[\mathcal C,\mathcal D]\longrightarrow[\mathcal C,\mathcal E],\qquad F\longmapsto H\circ F,\quad \eta\longmapsto(H(\eta_x))_x$$
is fully faithful: for every pair $F,G$, its map on natural transformations is a bijection.
